scope: English/shared texture-caption geometry aligned to the TXCL sampled cells, closing the latent EN defect noted in v4.1. EN boxes in intsys_04 (tex_gid 34), intsys_03 (tex_gid 33) and the intsys_01 link_icon (tex_gid 31) are now the sampled cells inset by 1 px with cell-wide clears, so no caption is clipped, none bleeds into a neighbouring cell and no JP remnants remain inside sampled cells. PL v4.1 text fixes unchanged; the PL intsys_04 render is byte-identical to v4.1 (326c2062...). intsys_03/intsys_01 captions are shared EN text in the PL kit, so those two textures follow the same fix there. TXCL rects for tex_gid 31/33/34 verified identical across IM1000/IM3000/IM9000 and the GIMs byte-identical across containers.
